title: merchant.fact.team_membership_changed v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 M2 — Merchant-owned store team membership fact. The invitee's phone number is never published: an invitation is addressed to a number that may not yet have an account, and that number is business PII.

merchant_id.description: Merchant aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

status.description: PENDING grants nothing: until the invitee accepts in their own account they see nothing of the store.

role.description: Customer App v3: 'For now every member is a warehouse keeper.'

member_principal_id.description: Known only once the invitee accepts. Null while PENDING.

store_ids.description: The branches this member works in. A member sees only these branches' parcels.
